standard_prerequisites.name: Termwise split sequences and the characterizing differential
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the characterization of delta as the unique map with d after s minus s after d equal to alpha after delta, which makes the candidate homotopy inverse (s, -delta) compatible with differentials.

standard_prerequisites.name: Admissible replacement of a morphism by a monomorphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, Lemmas lemma-make-injective, lemma-functorial-cone and lemma-third-isomorphism
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces part (2) to part (1): after replacing L by the admissible supertilde L, the two cone triangles are isomorphic, so f may be assumed an admissible monomorphism.

core_obligations: The comparison map and its homotopy inverse (proof lines 1102-1113): C(alpha) = L direct-sum K maps to M by the projection onto L followed by beta, a morphism of differential graded modules because K to L to M is zero; the inverse is (s, -delta) : M to C(alpha), compatible with differentials by the characterizing property of delta from the Homology lemma.

The homotopy to the identity (proof lines 1114-1136): the composite C(alpha) to M to C(alpha) is the displayed block matrix, and the displayed matrix identity exhibits identity minus the round trip as d h plus h d with the explicit homotopy h given by the block matrix with entry pi; the other composite M to C(alpha) to M is the identity.

Compatibility with the cone maps (proof lines 1137-1147): -p : C(alpha) to K[1] and the composite C(alpha) to M to K[1] agree up to homotopy; after precomposing with the homotopy inverse (s, -delta) this reduces to the two maps M to K[1], and p after (s, -delta) = -delta.

Part (2) (proof lines 1149-1160): factor f through the admissible monomorphism tilde f : K to tilde L from lemma-make-injective; by lemma-functorial-cone and lemma-third-isomorphism the two cone triangles are isomorphic and isomorphisms of triangles compose, so the general case follows from part (1).
proof_roadmap: Build the map C(alpha) to M and its homotopy inverse (s, -delta), checking differential compatibility via the characterizing property of delta.
Verify the homotopy identity with the explicitly displayed block matrices and homotopy h.
Check the cone maps agree up to homotopy by transporting along the homotopy inverse.
For part (2), replace f by an admissible monomorphism through the injective replacement and the cone-triangle isomorphisms, then apply part (1).
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the cone triangle of an admissible short exact sequence with the quotient up to homotopy equivalence of triangles, and reduces arbitrary morphisms to the admissible case (statement lines 1069-1099). The proof (lines 1101-1210) is a hands-on chain-level construction: the comparison map, the homotopy inverse (s, -delta) justified by the characterizing property of delta, the displayed matrix identity exhibiting identity minus the round trip as the homotopy differential of an explicit h, and the cone-map compatibility check, followed by the admissible-replacement reduction for part (2). H2: every step is explicit, the homotopy matrices are the content, and the author displays the verification identity in full (introducing it as trivial to verify).
